admission_rule: Admit a continuation envelope only when branch identity equals the canonical role branch and authority-file blob, plan_generation, LIVE blob and predecessor/current LATEST blob all equal the frozen current identities; reject the first mismatching identity without mutating durable LIVE state.
tested_scope: Deterministic in-memory continuation-envelope admission over one canonical CLEAN role branch and exact repository identities. Only branch identity varied between paired cases. This does not claim protection against external force-push/deletion, malicious authority-file replacement, or scheduler-global properties.
conflict_check: No O, downstream, other-worker state, protected primary, scheduler mutation or direct-main merge was used.
exact_continuation: Freshly bootstrap/freeze the four required controls; reconstruct the canonical role branch authority, then-current LATEST pointer and unchanged generation-3 LIVE state. In exactly one bounded in-memory envelope control, hold canonical branch, plan_generation=3, current LIVE blob and current LATEST blob fixed; supply an otherwise-current envelope carrying a synthetic stale or mismatched authority-file blob and require REJECT_STALE_AUTHORITY_BLOB, while the exact current authority-file blob is admitted. Verify LIVE unchanged; persist/read back and return recurring-open. Do not read another worker or archival substantive state, wait, poll, retry, mutate scheduler, or start a second leaf.
